intro: RESE.Q is an advanced rescue robot designed to assist first responders in collapsed or hazardous environments. Its modular, snake-like design lets it navigate rubble, tight passages, and unstable areas before human rescuers. With mapping and imaging tools, it generates 2D and 3D visualizations to guide operations in real time. Sensors detect and identify victims, obstacles, and hazards such as pipes, cylinders, or warning signs. An articulated arm enables inspection and remote actions like closing valves or opening doors. A dedicated module allows it to deliver supplies, such as first aid kits, to people in need. By uniting agility, versatility, and intelligence, RESE.Q enhances rescue missions and helps save lives.

reseq-mk1.title: What is RESE.Q MK1
reseq-mk1.description: It is the team’s first prototype to achieve the goal of creating an innovative robot for SAR operations. Our idea is to have a modular crawler robot with two possible configurations: robotic arm and crawler robot. So that he can easily navigate dangerous situations, to explore the environment without risking the lives of rescuers.

features.title: features
features.description:
Modular structure:
Allows you to adapt the robot to different scenarios, with specialized modules
Configuration snake-like:
Allows more agility in movement
strong>Robotic arm configuration:
For vertical lifting of part of the robot
Remote control:
Via a remote control and a camera on the robot, with future possibilities of autonomous and semi-autonomous driving.

objectives.title: Goals
objectives.description: The purpose of Rese. Q Mk1 is to provide support to rescuers in emergency situations. Its current capabilities are:

slides.1: Enter partially collapsed buildings before human rescuers, and navigate complex and partially collapsed environments
slides.2: Map the surrounding environment by generating a 2D map useful for rescuers, images and 3D visualizations of the environment
slides.3: Detect, locate, and recognize victims, hazards (pipes, gas cylinders, etc.), and signs inside the collapsed building (e.g., Hazmat warnings)
slides.4: Transport of food, medicine and other first aid items via a dedicated add-on module
slides.5: Securing dangerous areas, with the help of a gripper on the front module to act on any sources of risk
